landmarks.name: Tower Complex / Arena (32 Marine Parade, NR30 2EN)
landmarks.note: Real location: 32 Marine Parade, Great Yarmouth NR30 2EN (SIA Group sale particulars 'The Tower Complex, 32 Marine Parade'; staycation.co.uk / ukpostcodecheck.com list 32 Marine Parade NR30 2EN; visitgreatyarmouth.co.uk 'ATM outside The Tower' and ents24 give NR30 2EW). Coords = postcodes.io NR30 2EN centroid 52.604471,1.736196 (NR30 2EW: 52.604497,1.736213); cross-checked with OSM Nominatim 'Oasis Tower, Marine Parade, NR30 2EN' at 52.6044981,1.7361511. Lies on Marine Parade ~410 m SOUTH of Britannia Pier and ~575 m NORTH of Wellington Pier, south of the Regent Road junction (Regent Road meets Marine Parade near Britannia Pier). Postcode data: Royal Mail/OS via postcodes.io (OGL).
